entities.summary: Bertha Swirles, Lady Jeffreys was an English physicist, academic and scientific author who carried out research on quantum theory in its early days. She was associated with Girton College, University of Cambridge, as student and Fellow, for over 70 years. Bertha Swirles was a logicians & mathematicians from Northampton (1903-05-22, Northampton–1999-12-18). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
